extraction_notes: Extracted experimental performance rows from SI Table S1. SI Table S2 was treated as a literature-comparison table; its two 'This work' rows duplicate SI Table S1 entries and were not added as separate records. SI Figure S4B plots Cat-4.5 and H-In2O3/Al2O3 performance under the same conditions, but the tabulated SI Table S1 values are more exact and were used instead. Characterization data in SI Table S3 and SI Figures S1–S3/S5 were out of scope.
